query:
SELECT id, name, phone, email, stage, follow_up_date, created_at
FROM leads
WHERE name LIKE '%Sarah%Sahota%'
   OR name LIKE '%Sharanpreet%Singh%'
   OR name LIKE '%Jaskaran%'
   OR name LIKE '%Vitek%'
   OR name LIKE '%Vishal%kumar%'
   OR name LIKE '%Sujeet%Singh%'
   OR name LIKE '%Balwant%singh%'
   OR name LIKE '%Tarunjot%Singh%'
   OR name LIKE '%Henry%Wang%'
ORDER BY created_at DESC;
